steps.do: Cut each celery stalk into 3 pieces.
Fill the groove of each piece with peanut butter.
Line raisins along the top.

apple-cinnamon-muffins.name: Apple Cinnamon Muffins
apple-cinnamon-muffins.summary: Soft muffins full of apple and cinnamon.

steps.do: Preheat the oven to 375°F and line a 12-cup muffin tin.
Peel and dice the apples.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and 1 1/2 tsp cinnamon.
Whisk the eggs, milk and butter, then stir them into the flour until just mixed.
Fold in the apples and fill the cups.
Mix the brown sugar with the rest of the cinnamon and sprinkle on top.
Bake for 22 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.

apple-crumble.name: Apple Crumble
apple-crumble.summary: Soft cinnamon apples under a crunchy oat topping.

steps.do: Preheat the oven to 375°F.
Peel and slice the apples. Toss with the lemon, sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon in a baking dish.
Rub the flour, oats, brown sugar, the rest of the cinnamon and the cold butter together into crumbs.
Scatter the crumbs over the apples.
Bake for 40 minutes, until bubbling and golden.
Peel the bananas and break them into chunks.
Put the bananas, milk, yogurt, honey and ice in the blender.
Blend until smooth and pour into glasses.

beef-chili.name: Beef and Bean Chili
beef-chili.summary: Hearty beef chili with kidney beans and all the toppings.

ingredients.line: 1 can canned crushed tomatoes (28 oz can)
2 cans canned kidney beans, drained (15 oz cans)

steps.do: Dice the onion and pepper and mince the garlic.
Cook them in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the beef and brown it for 8 minutes, breaking it up.
Stir in the chili powder, cumin, paprika and salt for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans and stock. Simmer for 45 minutes, stirring now and then.
Check it reads 160°F, then serve topped with cheddar and sour cream.

berry-fruit-salad.name: Berry Fruit Salad
berry-fruit-salad.summary: Bright berries with honey, lime and mint.

steps.do: Slice the strawberries.
Put the strawberries, blueberries and raspberries in a bowl.
Squeeze the lime and stir the juice with the honey.
Pour over the berries, add the mint and toss gently.

bibimbap.name: Bibimbap
bibimbap.summary: Rice bowl with seasoned beef, vegetables, a fried egg and gochujang.

steps.do: Cook the rice in the water, covered, for 15 minutes, then rest it.
Mince the garlic, shred the carrots and slice the zucchini.
Cook the beef with the soy sauce, sugar and garlic for 6 minutes, breaking it up. It should reach 160°F.
Stir-fry each vegetable in a little vegetable oil for 2 minutes, one at a time.
Fry the eggs in the rest of the oil for 3 minutes.
Fill bowls with rice, arrange the beef and vegetables on top, then the egg.
Add gochujang, a drizzle of sesame oil and sesame seeds.

blt-sandwich.name: BLT
blt-sandwich.summary: Crispy bacon, crunchy lettuce and ripe tomato on toast.

steps.do: Cook the bacon in a pan for 8 minutes, turning now and then, until crisp.
Drain the bacon on a paper towel. Toast the bread meanwhile.
Slice the tomato.
Spread mayonnaise on the toast.
Layer lettuce, tomato and 3 slices of bacon on 2 slices of toast, top with the rest and cut in half.

butternut-squash-soup.name: Butternut Squash Soup
butternut-squash-soup.summary: Velvety roasted squash soup with a hint of nutmeg.

steps.do: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Peel the squash, scoop out the seeds and cut it into cubes.
Toss the squash with 1 tbsp oil and roast for 30 minutes.
Chop the onion and mince the garlic.
Cook the onion and garlic in the rest of the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the squash and stock and simmer for 10 minutes.
Blend until smooth, then stir in the cream, nutmeg, salt and pepper.

caesar-salad.name: Caesar Salad
caesar-salad.summary: Crisp romaine with a creamy garlic-parmesan dressing and croutons.

steps.do: Preheat the oven to 375°F.
Cube the bread and toss it with 2 tbsp olive oil.
Bake the cubes for 10 minutes, until crunchy.
Mince the garlic and anchovies, then whisk them with the mayonnaise, lemon, mustard, the rest of the oil and half the parmesan.
Toss the romaine with the dressing and croutons.
Top with the rest of the parmesan and pepper.

cafe-de-olla.name: Café de Olla
cafe-de-olla.summary: Mexican coffee brewed with cinnamon and brown sugar.

steps.do: Bring the water, cinnamon, brown sugar and orange peel to a boil.
Simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the coffee, take it off the heat and steep for 5 minutes.
Strain into mugs.

caprese-salad.name: Caprese Salad
caprese-salad.summary: Tomato, fresh mozzarella and basil with good olive oil.

steps.do: Slice the tomatoes and mozzarella.
Overlap them on a plate with a basil leaf between each.
Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.

caramel-apples.name: Caramel Apples
caramel-apples.summary: Crisp apples dipped in homemade caramel.

steps.do: Push a stick into the top of each apple and line a tray with parchment.
Chop the peanuts.
Cook the sugar and water without stirring for 10 minutes, until amber. A grown-up does this part: it's very hot.
Off the heat, whisk in the butter, then the warm cream, vanilla and salt.
Cool the caramel for 5 minutes.
Dip each apple, let it drip, then roll the bottom in peanuts.
Set on the tray for 30 minutes.

chana-masala.name: Chana Masala
chana-masala.summary: Chickpeas simmered in a spiced tomato and onion gravy.

ingredients.line: 2 cans canned chickpeas, drained (15 oz cans)

steps.do: Dice the onion, mince the garlic and grate the ginger.
Cook the onion in the oil for 8 minutes, until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, turmeric and chili powder for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the chickpeas, water and salt. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the garam masala and lemon juice, and top with cilantro.

chicken-noodle-soup.name: Chicken Noodle Soup
chicken-noodle-soup.summary: Classic soup with chicken, vegetables and egg noodles.

steps.do: Dice the onion and slice the carrots and celery.
Cook the vegetables in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken, stock, thyme and bay leaf. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Lift out the chicken and check it reads 165°F, then shred it with two forks.
Add the noodles and cook for 7 minutes.
Return the chicken, take out the bay leaf and thyme stems, and season.
Top with parsley.

chicken-souvlaki-pitas.name: Chicken Souvlaki Pitas
chicken-souvlaki-pitas.summary: Lemon-garlic chicken skewers wrapped in warm pita.

steps.do: Cube the chicken and mince the garlic.
Mix the chicken with 2 tbsp oil, the lemon, garlic, oregano and salt. Marinate for 30 minutes.
Thread onto skewers and cook in a grill pan for 10 minutes, turning.
Check a piece: 165°F inside.
Warm the pitas in the pan for 1 minute.
Slice the tomato and onion.
Fill the pitas with chicken, lettuce, tomato and onion.

chicken-tacos.name: Chicken Tacos
chicken-tacos.summary: Spiced chicken thighs in warm tortillas.

steps.do: Rub the chicken with the chili powder, cumin, garlic powder and salt.
Heat the oil in a pan and cook the chicken for 6 minutes a side.
Check the thickest piece: it should read 165°F inside.
Rest the chicken for 5 minutes, then slice it.
Squeeze the lime over the chicken.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan, 30 seconds a side.
Fill with chicken, lettuce, cheddar, sour cream and cilantro.

chilaquiles.name: Chilaquiles Rojos
chilaquiles.summary: Crispy tortillas in red salsa, topped with fried eggs.

steps.do: Cut each tortilla into 6 wedges.
Fry the wedges in 3 tbsp oil for 5 minutes, in batches, until crisp.
Blend the tomatoes, onion, garlic, jalapeño and salt.
Simmer the salsa for 5 minutes.
Fry the eggs in the last tbsp of oil for 3 minutes, until the whites are set.
Toss the chips in the salsa and top with the eggs, queso fresco, sour cream and cilantro.
Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Beat the butter, sugar and brown sugar until fluffy.
Beat in the egg and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking soda and salt, then the chocolate chips.
Scoop tablespoon balls onto a lined sheet, 2 inches apart.
Bake for 11 minutes, until the edges are golden.
Cool on the sheet for 5 minutes.

chocolate-mousse.name: Chocolate Mousse
chocolate-mousse.summary: Light, rich chocolate mousse made with whipped cream.

steps.do: Chop the chocolate.
Warm 1/2 cup cream until steaming, about 3 minutes.
Pour it over the chocolate, wait 1 minute, then stir until smooth.
Whip the rest of the cream with the sugar, vanilla and salt to soft peaks.
Fold the whipped cream into the chocolate in 3 parts.
Spoon into glasses and chill for 2 hours.
Preheat the oven to 400°F with a buttered skillet inside.
Whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Whisk in the milk, eggs and the rest of the melted butter.
Pour into the hot skillet and bake for 22 minutes.
Cut into wedges.

cranberry-sauce.name: Cranberry Sauce
cranberry-sauce.summary: Fresh cranberries cooked down with orange.

steps.do: Zest and juice the orange.
Put the cranberries, sugar, orange and water in a pot.
Simmer for 12 minutes, until most berries pop.
Cool. It thickens as it cools.

crispy-potatoes.name: Crispy Roast Potatoes
crispy-potatoes.summary: Potatoes roasted until crunchy with rosemary.

steps.do: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Cut the potatoes into 1 inch chunks.
Toss with the oil, salt and rosemary on a sheet pan.
Roast for 45 minutes, turning halfway.

croque-monsieur.name: Croque Monsieur
croque-monsieur.summary: A toasted ham and Gruyère sandwich under creamy béchamel.

steps.do: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the milk for 4 minutes, until thick.
Stir in the nutmeg, salt and 1/2 cup Gruyère.
Spread mustard on 4 slices of bread, add 2 slices of ham each, then close the sandwiches.
Spoon the sauce over the tops and scatter on the rest of the Gruyère.
Bake for 12 minutes, until bubbling and browned.

cumin-rice.name: Cumin Rice
cumin-rice.summary: Fluffy basmati-style rice toasted with cumin seeds.

steps.do: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear.
Melt the butter and fry the cumin seeds for 1 minute.
Add the rice, water and salt and bring to a boil.
Cover and cook for 15 minutes.
Rest for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.

fluffy-pancakes.name: Fluffy Pancakes
fluffy-pancakes.summary: Tall, soft pancakes with maple syrup.

steps.do: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a big bowl.
In another bowl, whisk the milk, egg and 3 tbsp of the melted butter.
Pour the wet into the dry and stir until just mixed. Small lumps are fine.
Brush a pan with the last of the butter. Pour in 1/4 cup of batter per pancake.
Cook for 2 minutes, until bubbles pop on top.
Flip and cook 1 minute more, until golden.
Serve warm with maple syrup.
Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Mince the garlic and mix it into the butter with the parsley.
Split the baguette lengthwise and spread the butter over the cut sides.
Bake for 10 minutes, until golden.
Slice and serve.

garlic-green-beans.name: Garlic Green Beans
garlic-green-beans.summary: Snappy green beans with garlic butter and almonds.

steps.do: Boil the green beans in the water for 4 minutes, then drain.
Slice the garlic.
Melt the butter in a pan and cook the garlic for 1 minute.
Toss in the beans, almonds and salt.

grilled-cheese-croutons.name: Grilled Cheese Croutons
grilled-cheese-croutons.summary: Little grilled cheese squares to float on soup.

steps.do: Butter one side of each slice of bread.
Make 2 sandwiches with the cheddar inside and the butter outside.
Cook for 4 minutes a side, until golden and melted.
Cut each sandwich into 16 small squares.

grilled-cheese.name: Grilled Cheese
grilled-cheese.summary: Golden, buttery bread around melted cheddar.

steps.do: Spread butter on one side of every slice of bread.
Lay 2 slices butter side down and put 2 slices of cheddar on each. Top with the other bread, butter side up.
Cook in a pan for 4 minutes, until the bottom is golden.
Flip with a spatula and cook the other side for 4 minutes, until the cheese melts.
Cut each sandwich in half.

guacamole.name: Guacamole
guacamole.summary: Chunky avocado dip with lime and cilantro.

steps.do: Dice the onion and tomato and mince the jalapeño.
Halve the avocados, scoop them into a bowl and mash with a fork.
Stir in the lime juice and salt.
Fold in the onion, tomato, jalapeño and cilantro.

herb-stuffing.name: Herb Stuffing
herb-stuffing.summary: Crisp-topped bread stuffing with celery, onion and sage.

steps.do: Preheat the oven to 350°F and butter a baking dish.
Cube the bread and dice the onion and celery.
Cook the onion and celery in the rest of the butter for 8 minutes.
Stir in the sage, thyme and salt.
Toss with the bread, stock and egg, and spread in the dish.
Cover and bake for 25 minutes.
Uncover and bake 20 minutes more, until crisp on top and 165°F in the middle.

homemade-pizza.name: Homemade Pizza
homemade-pizza.summary: Make the dough, then everyone tops their own.

steps.do: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and 1 tsp salt. Stir in the warm water and 2 tbsp oil.
Knead for 5 minutes, until smooth.
Cover and let it rise for 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 475°F. Stir the oregano and the rest of the salt into the tomatoes.
Split the dough in 2 and stretch each into a round on an oiled sheet.
Spread the sauce, then add mozzarella and pepperoni.
Bake for 12 minutes, until the crust is golden and the cheese bubbles.
Top with basil and cut into slices.

honey-yogurt-walnuts.name: Greek Yogurt with Honey and Walnuts
honey-yogurt-walnuts.summary: Thick yogurt with warm honey and toasted walnuts.

steps.do: Toast the walnuts in a dry pan for 3 minutes.
Spoon the yogurt into bowls.
Top with walnuts, a drizzle of honey and a pinch of cinnamon.

leftover-turkey-sandwich.name: The Day-After Turkey Sandwich
leftover-turkey-sandwich.summary: Leftover turkey, cranberry and Swiss on sourdough.

steps.do: Toast the sourdough.
Spread mayonnaise on 2 slices and cranberry sauce on the other 2.
Layer the turkey, Swiss and lettuce.
Close the sandwiches and cut them in half.

lemon-ricotta-cake.name: Lemon Ricotta Cake
lemon-ricotta-cake.summary: A moist, tender cake with ricotta and lemon.

steps.do: Preheat the oven to 350°F and butter a 9 inch round pan.
Beat the butter and sugar until fluffy, then beat in the eggs one at a time.
Zest and juice the lemon and beat it in with the ricotta.
Fold in the flour, baking powder and salt.
Bake for 40 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool for 20 minutes, then dust with powdered sugar.

mango-lassi.name: Mango Lassi
mango-lassi.summary: Cool mango and yogurt drink with cardamom.

steps.do: Put the mango, yogurt, milk, sugar and cardamom in the blender.
Blend until smooth and pour into glasses.
Peel and cube the potatoes.
Cover with the water, add 1 tsp salt and boil for 15 minutes.
Drain and mash with the butter.
Stir in the warm milk and the rest of the salt.

miso-soup.name: Miso Soup
miso-soup.summary: Light dashi broth with miso, tofu and seaweed.

steps.do: Soak the wakame in water for 5 minutes, then drain.
Cut the tofu into small cubes and slice the green onions.
Heat the dashi until steaming.
Add the tofu and wakame for 2 minutes.
Whisk the miso with a ladle of broth, then stir it back in. Don't let it boil.
Top with green onion.

monster-green-smoothie.name: Monster Green Smoothie
monster-green-smoothie.summary: A spooky-green spinach, banana and pineapple smoothie.

steps.do: Put the spinach, banana, pineapple, milk and yogurt in the blender.
Blend until smooth and bright green.
Pour into glasses.

mummy-hot-dogs.name: Mummy Hot Dogs
mummy-hot-dogs.summary: Hot dogs wrapped in puff pastry bandages with mustard eyes.

steps.do: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Cut the pastry into thin strips with a pizza cutter.
Wrap the strips around each hot dog like bandages, leaving a gap for the face.
Brush the pastry with beaten egg.
Bake for 18 minutes, until puffed and golden.
Dot on 2 mustard eyes.

onigiri.name: Tuna Mayo Onigiri
onigiri.summary: Rice balls with a tuna mayo filling, wrapped in nori.

steps.do: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear.
Cook the rice in the water, covered, for 15 minutes.
Rest it, still covered, for 10 minutes.
Mix the tuna with the mayonnaise.
Wet your hands, rub on a little salt and press a handful of rice flat.
Put a spoon of tuna in the middle, close the rice around it and press into a triangle.
Wrap the bottom in a strip of nori.

pan-seared-steak.name: Pan-Seared Steak
pan-seared-steak.summary: A crusty steak basted with garlic butter.

steps.do: Pat the steaks dry and season well with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a heavy pan until it shimmers.
Sear the steaks for 4 minutes without moving them.
Flip, add the butter, garlic and thyme, and spoon the butter over the steaks for 4 minutes.
Check the middle: 145°F for medium.
Rest for 5 minutes, then slice against the grain.

peanut-butter-toast.name: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
peanut-butter-toast.summary: Toast with peanut butter, banana and a drizzle of honey.

steps.do: Toast the bread.
Spread the peanut butter on the toast.
Slice the banana with a butter knife and lay it on top.
Drizzle with honey.
Preheat the oven to 425°F and set the crust in a pie dish.
Whisk the pumpkin, evaporated milk, eggs, brown sugar, spices and salt.
Pour into the crust and bake for 15 minutes.
Lower the oven to 350°F and bake 40 minutes more.
Cool for 2 hours before slicing.

roast-chicken.name: Lemon Herb Roast Chicken
roast-chicken.summary: A whole chicken roasted with lemon, garlic and thyme.

steps.do: Preheat the oven to 425°F. Pat the chicken dry.
Rub the butter all over and season with salt and pepper.
Halve the lemon and put it inside with the garlic and thyme.
Roast for 75 minutes.
Check the thickest part of the thigh: 165°F.
Rest for 10 minutes before carving.

roast-turkey-breast.name: Herb Roast Turkey Breast
roast-turkey-breast.summary: A juicy bone-in turkey breast with sage butter.

steps.do: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Chop the sage and thyme leaves and mince the garlic. Mash them into the butter with the salt and pepper.
Pat the turkey dry and rub the butter under and over the skin.
Roast for 105 minutes, basting halfway.
Check the thickest part: 165°F.
Rest for 20 minutes, then carve.
Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Cut the broccoli into florets.
Toss with olive oil, salt and pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast for 20 minutes, until the edges are browned.
Squeeze lemon over the top.

scrambled-eggs-on-toast.name: Soft Scrambled Eggs on Toast
scrambled-eggs-on-toast.summary: Slow, creamy scrambled eggs on buttered toast.

steps.do: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Melt 1 tbsp butter in a pan over low heat and pour in the eggs.
Stir slowly for 5 minutes, until softly set.
Toast the bread and butter it with the rest of the butter.
Spoon the eggs onto the toast and top with chives and pepper.

spaghetti-al-limone.name: Spaghetti al Limone
spaghetti-al-limone.summary: Spaghetti in a silky lemon, butter and parmesan sauce.

steps.do: Boil the water with the salt and cook the spaghetti for 9 minutes.
Zest and juice the lemons.
Save 1 cup of pasta water, then drain.
Melt the butter with the oil in the pot, add the lemon and a splash of pasta water.
Toss in the spaghetti and parmesan for 2 minutes, adding pasta water until glossy.
Finish with black pepper.

spaghetti-and-meatballs.name: Spaghetti and Meatballs
spaghetti-and-meatballs.summary: Tender meatballs simmered in tomato sauce over spaghetti.

ingredients.line: 1 can canned crushed tomatoes (28 oz can)

steps.do: Mince 2 cloves of garlic for the meatballs and the last one for the sauce. Dice the onion.
Mix the beef, breadcrumbs, egg, 1/2 cup parmesan, parsley, 1 tsp salt and the pepper. Roll into 16 balls.
Brown the meatballs in the oil for 6 minutes, turning, then lift them out.
Cook the onion in the same pan for 4 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, return the meatballs, cover and simmer for 20 minutes.
Check a meatball: 160°F inside.
Meanwhile, boil the water with the rest of the salt and cook the spaghetti for 9 minutes. Drain.
Stir the basil into the sauce and serve over the spaghetti with the rest of the parmesan.

stovetop-mac-and-cheese.name: Stovetop Mac and Cheese
stovetop-mac-and-cheese.summary: Creamy cheddar mac and cheese made in one pot.

steps.do: Bring the water and 1/2 tsp salt to a boil.
Cook the pasta for 7 minutes, then drain.
Melt the butter in the pot, stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Whisk in the milk a little at a time and cook for 4 minutes, until thick.
Take off the heat and stir in the cheddar, mustard powder and the rest of the salt.
Stir the pasta back in.

sweet-crepes.name: Sweet Crêpes
sweet-crepes.summary: Thin crêpes with sugar and lemon or jam.

steps.do: Whisk the flour, eggs, milk, 2 tbsp butter, 1 tbsp sugar and vanilla until smooth.
Rest the batter for 10 minutes.
Brush a pan with the rest of the butter and pour in 1/4 cup of batter, tilting to spread it thin.
Cook for 1 minute, flip and cook 30 seconds more.
Fill with sugar and a squeeze of lemon, or with jam, and fold into quarters.

tomato-soup.name: Creamy Tomato Soup
tomato-soup.summary: A smooth, gently creamy tomato soup for dunking.

ingredients.line: 2 cans canned crushed tomatoes (28 oz cans)

steps.do: Chop the onion and mince the garlic.
Melt the butter in a pot and cook the onion for 5 minutes, until soft.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, stock and sugar. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth. A grown-up holds the lid down with a towel.
Stir in the cream and basil, then season with salt and pepper.

turkey-cheese-pinwheels.name: Turkey and Cheese Pinwheels
turkey-cheese-pinwheels.summary: Rolled-up tortilla spirals for the lunchbox.

steps.do: Spread the cream cheese all over each tortilla.
Layer turkey, cheddar and spinach on top.
Roll each tortilla up tightly.
Cut each roll into 6 slices.

tzatziki.name: Tzatziki
tzatziki.summary: Cool Greek yogurt sauce with cucumber, garlic and dill.

steps.do: Grate the cucumber and squeeze out the water.
Mince the garlic and chop the dill.
Stir everything into the yogurt with the lemon and salt.
Drizzle with olive oil.

warm-spiced-cider.name: Warm Spiced Cider
warm-spiced-cider.summary: Apple cider simmered with cinnamon, cloves and orange.

steps.do: Slice the orange.
Put the cider, cinnamon sticks, cloves and orange in a pot.
Simmer for 15 minutes.
Ladle into mugs, leaving the spices behind.
